quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical press release: release 2608072 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical raised its consolidated forecasts (previous forecast published May 13, 2026). FY ending March 2027 (full year): net sales 860,000 million yen (previous 840,000), operating profit 71,000 million yen (previous 59,000; +20.3%), ordinary profit 79,000 million yen (previous 66,000), net profit attributable to owners 55,000 million yen (previous 46,000). First half (April 1 to September 30, 2026): net sales 440,000 million yen (previous 420,000), operating profit 41,000 million yen (previous 28,000; +46.4%), ordinary profit 46,000 million yen (previous 31,000), net profit 31,000 million yen (previous 20,000). Company's stated reasons: higher market prices for methanol and engineering plastics amid heightened Middle East tensions, inventory valuation effects, and a weaker-yen exchange-rate assumption; the full-year raise follows the first-half profit beat. FX assumption for the remaining months: 160 yen per US dollar and 185 yen per euro (each 5 yen weaker than before). The company notes actual results may differ.
